description: A monitor's uptime percentage and response times (p50, p95, p99) over a period, in hourly or daily buckets, overall or for one region. Use it for SLA questions and "was it slow yesterday?".

days.description: Look back this many days (default 7). Ignored when from is given.

include_buckets.description: Include the per-hour or per-day series, not just the totals (default false).

region.description: One region code from list_regions, e.g. ams, nyc or tlv. Leave out for all regions.

name: get_uptime_report
title: Uptime and response time report
